name: Ayurvedic Treatment of Leucoderma

sections.introduction:
Everybody wants healthy, glowing and youthful skin. We all are born with soft and radiant skin. Skin tones vary from person to person. Some people think that skin is the outermost visible layer of our body. But the real truth is that skin is the first layer of our immune system. Like other vital parts of our body, skin plays vital functions in our body. As we grow our skin becomes thinner and rough. So many unpleasant things happen to our skin. Our skin also needs a healthy lifestyle and nutrition rich diet. Healthy skin needs proper sleep, nutritious diet, regular exercise and plenty of water. But these days life is full of stress and people are on an unhealthy diet. These all factors lead to various skin disorders. 

 About Leucoderma 
 Leucoderma is a condition of white patches on our skin. 
 Our skin is differentiated into three different layers:- 

 Epidermis (outermost layer) 
 Dermis (beneath the dermis) 
 Hypodermis (deeper subcutaneous tissue) 

 IIn our body skin color is created by special cells. These melanin pigment producing cells are called melanocytes. When melanocytes are not able to produce sufficient color for our body then this condition occurs. Patches formed on our body are called macules. These lesions found in the body are painless. Size of macules vary and can be found on any part of the body. 
 Mostly affected parts are:- 

 Face 
 Lips 
 Hand 
 Feet 
 Axilla 
 Groin 
 Genital organs
sections.causes_of_leucoderma: There is no known cause for this disorder. It is an autoimmune disorder in which the body is destroying its own cells, tissues and genetics. Rarely may be due to external accidents like burns, body cuts and body scars. In all these external accidental conditions melanocytes are destroyed. People who are suffering with metal stress and chronic gastric disorders are also more prone to leucoderma.
sections.symptoms_of_leucoderma:
Gradually the condition starts with a simple spot on the body and it gets converted into patches or spread to the whole body. 
 In some cases premature graying of scalp hair and eyelashes are also seen. 
 Ayurvedic Aspect 
 In ayurvedic literature “kusth” is classified into eighteen different types. “SHIVTRA” OR “SHWETA KUSTHA” is an ayurvedic term used for leucoderma. This disorder is non-infectious and white patches are formed on skin. Main cause of Shivtra is the aggravation of pitta dosha. Pitta dosha symbolizes heat and warmth and it manifests below our skin. Excessive aggravation of pitta dosha under our skin leads to collection of ama (toxins) and causes this condition called leucoderma. In the human body five types of pitta are found and bhrajak pitta is responsible for coloration of skin. 
 Imbalance of bhrajak pitta —–enters deeper body tissue (rasa, rakta and lasika) —- skin starts losing its natural color —- white patches formed in skin.
sections.according_to_ayurveda_following_are_main:
Virudh aahar (contradictory food and drinks) 
 Suppression of natural urges 
 Physical exercise in excessive heat 
 Stress and trauma (abhighat)
